moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-long-shadow-grow, written here): Stack of copies (or text-shadows) behind the text, copy k offset (k px, k px) at 45° (demo every 0.75 px); length L grows 0 → 60 px (demo ≤ 48 px, limited by space) over 0.8 s power2.out (easeOutCubic); copies are accent mixed toward the background by 30 % → 85 % with distance (a colour fade, not opacity); main text on top. Demo grows 0.3–1.1 s, retracts 2.5–2.9 s (inCubic); loop 3.2 s. Params: length: độ dài bóng (60 px) · angle (45°) · duration (0.8 s, ease-out) · color: màu bóng (màu nhấn). A colour fade with distance (30 % → 85 % toward the background), not opacity.
